results.name: E1 AP-01 app hub: the live module registry is launchable; real manifest handlers, display mode and origin quota are shown without inventing installed apps or OS associations
E2 AP-05 inventory: actual service-worker registrations and sync tags match Chromium APIs; page callback counters are measured and clearly not OS wake counts
E3 PR-07h per-site browser identity: desktop is the default, a mobile override is host-scoped and survives same-site navigation, and another host remains on default
